supersedes: GPU/shared-memory-controller utilization gates from GPU_SHARED_EXECUTION_POLICY_20261008.json and the old prefix package resource-policy description, for fresh attempts. Utilization is recorded but never rejects admission.
interpretation: Utilization measures activity over a sampling interval, not a fixed compute quota. Concurrent contexts may share compute time with variable throughput; no guarantee that unrelated workloads cannot fail.
preserved_constraints: No stopping, reprioritizing or changing unrelated processes or GPU global settings.
Original scientific package/checkpoints/inputs/random addresses/prediction paths/metrics/tolerances remain fixed.
One GPU per fresh attempt; 600 seconds absolute deadline and 24GiB allocated cap, not a reservation.
First timeout/OOM/nonfinite/identity/count/software fault stops the queue; no automatic retry, fallback or resume.
Native UUID isolation and project-exclusive lock; record raw resource samples and compute processes.
